title: A CHARGED-OFF AND FRAUD loan with NO charge-off reason credits CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE and debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY, not the product's reason-mapped account (loan 10 L479: CREDIT account 16 36.26, DEBIT account 22 36.26)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_AMORTIZATION transaction posts on a loan that IS CHARGED OFF AND FRAUD, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_CHARGE_OFF_REASON) at the amortization transaction L479. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's amortization transaction id 479 (type loanTransactionType.buyDownFeeAmortization): interestPortion 36.26 -> "3626" and feeChargesPortion 0 -> "0" minor units. The loan read-back carries a NON-REVERSED chargeOff transaction id 478 dated 2024-01-25 with a LOWER id than the amortization (both are dated 2024-01-25, so the id order decides), the charge-off request carries NO reason, and the loan's fraud flag is true, so request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.charged_off and fraud are both true; the loan is NOT written off. request.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_CHARGE_OFF_REASON.json: incomeFromBuyDownAccountId 24, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, writeOffAccountId 15, chargeOffExpenseAccountId 18, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 16. THIS PRODUCT ALSO CARRIES chargeOffReasonToExpenseAccountMappings [{code 24 -> 16}, {code 33 -> 18}, {code 37 -> 18}], but the observed charge-off request carries NO reason, so the FRAUD branch applies and the amortization credits 16. A port that used the product's reason mapping would post 18 and fail this vector. expect.buy_down_fee_amortization_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L479 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 995 entryType CREDIT glAccountId 16 amount 36.26 and id 996 DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 36.26. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a charged-off fraud loan's amortization credits CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE (16), not income from buy down (24), not the non-fraud charge-off account (18) and not the reason-mapped account, and debits the same total to deferred income liability. It is the account cell that discriminates both the ignore-loan-state drive and a reason-mapping port. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive fee portion (zero here), the written-off arm, and the buy-down-fee CLASSIFICATION branch (not observed, no input). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
